lines.text: Hi there, so what are you coming in with?
I'm coming in with pain between my shoulder blades for about two months, give or take.
And how did it start?
I'd been painting the ceiling all weekend, I'm certain that set it off.
It's worst in the evenings after sitting at my laptop.
Any previous surgery or problems with your back?
The only previous surgery was keyhole on my gallbladder, I think, years ago.
Does it ever hurt when you breathe in deeply, or wake you up at night?
Only if I roll onto it.
Let me have a look. There's a stiff segment in the middle of your upper back, and it's tender just to the right of the spine.
I think what's going on is a stiff joint in the upper back, it's very common with long spells at a desk.
I'd like to do a manipulation, a quick thrust that sometimes makes a click. Are you okay for a crack?
Go on then, I'm up for a crack.
Okay, deep breath out.
How's that?
Oh, that's freed it, I'm moving a bit better already.
Raise your laptop so the top of the screen is at eye level, and get up every forty minutes.
Sit on a chair, hug yourself, and twist slowly left and right, ten each way, a few times a day.
Great, see you next week.
Lovely, thanks.
